faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What tools are available in the GST Hub?
faq.a1: The Hub includes the Diligence Machine, which generates customized technology due diligence agendas based on target parameters. We also provide reference architectures, integration checklists, and VDR structure templates drawn from patterns proven across 100+ engagements.
faq.q2: Are the Hub tools free to use?
faq.a2: Yes. Every interactive tool, framework, and reference in the GST Hub is freely available in the browser, whether or not you engage GST for advisory work. The one thing that is provisioned rather than open is the MCP Server, which lets your own AI agents call these same tools programmatically: access there is granted per client, with a free pilot tier.
faq.q3: Who are these resources designed for?
faq.a3: The Hub is built for private equity investors evaluating technology assets, portfolio company executives managing platform transitions, and technical leaders navigating complex architecture decisions. The content is calibrated for professionals who need actionable insight, not generic advice.
